1.word_for_word: षड्विंशे विस्मितान् गोपान् कृष्णस्याद्भुत-कर्मभिः । — In the twenty-sixth century, the cowherd men were astonished at the wonderful deeds of Lord Kṛṣṇa.; नन्दो गर्गोक्तिम् आश्राव्य तद्-ऐश्वर्यम् अवर्णयत् ॥ — After hearing the words of Garga, Nanda Mahārāja described the opulence of the Lord.; समभ्येत्य नन्दम् अभिगम्य ॥१॥ — They approached Nanda and approached him.
1.translation: In the twenty-sixth century, the cowherd men were astonished at the wonderful deeds of Lord Kṛṣṇa. After hearing the words of Garga, Nanda Mahārāja described the opulence of the Lord. They approached Nanda and approached him.

2.word_for_word: यद् ऊचुः, तद् आह---बालकस्येति । — What they said, he said, was that of the child.; यद् यस्माद् अद्भुतानि कर्माणि, तस्माद् ग्राम्येषु गोपालेषु कथं जन्मार्हति ? — How can he be born among the rural cowherds from whom he has performed wonderful deeds?; आत्म-जुगुप्सितम् आत्मानर्हम् ॥२॥ — Self-despised and self-worthy.
2.translation: What they said, he said, was that of the child. How can he be born among the rural cowherds from whom he has performed wonderful deeds? Self-despised and self-worthy.

3.word_for_word: अद्भुतानि कर्माण्य् आहुह्---यः सप्त-हायन इति । — They call him the wonderful deeds of the seven-year-old.; कथं बिभ्रत् स्थितः ? — How did he stand carrying?; इति । — It is.; पुष्करं पद्मं गज-राण् महा-गज इव ॥३॥ — The lotus flower is like a great elephant in the kingdom of elephants.
3.translation: They call him the wonderful deeds of the seven-year-old. How did he stand carrying? It is. The lotus flower is like a great elephant in the kingdom of elephants.

4.word_for_word: महौजसो महा-बलायाः तनोर् वय आयुर् यौवनं वा कालेन यथा पीयते, तद्वत् । — Just as the age, longevity or youth of the body of a greatly powerful person is drunk by time,; कथम् इत्य् अनुवर्तते ॥४॥ — How, it follows.
4.translation: Just as the age, longevity or youth of the body of a greatly powerful person is drunk by time, How, it follows.

5.word_for_word: अनसोऽधः शयानस्य । — of lying under Anaso.; मास्यस्य मासास् त्रयः परिच्छेदका यस्य । — The months of the month are the three intersections of the month.; उदग् ऊर्ध्वं चरणौ हिन्वतश् चालयतः । — His feet moved upwards and downwards.; प्रपदेन पादाग्रेण हतं विपर्यस्तम् अनः कथम् अपतत् ? — How did Ana fall upside down, killed by the tip of her foot?; ॥५॥ — ॥5॥
5.translation: of lying under Anaso. The months of the month are the three intersections of the month. His feet moved upwards and downwards. How did Ana fall upside down, killed by the tip of her foot? ॥5॥

6.word_for_word: यः कृष्णो दैत्येन ह्रियमाणः संस् तं तृणावर्तं दैत्यं कथम् अहन्न् इत्य् अर्थः ॥६॥ — That is to say, how did Krishna, who was being carried away by the demon, kill that demon who was covered with grass?
6.translation: That is to say, how did Krishna, who was being carried away by the demon, kill that demon who was covered with grass?

7.word_for_word: हैयङ्गव-स्तैन्ये नव-नीत-चौर्ये । — In the newly brought theft of the Haiyangva-stainye.; बाहुभ्यां गच्छन् रिङ्गन्न् इत्य् अर्थः ॥७॥ — This means that he walks with his arms and rings.
7.translation: In the newly brought theft of the Haiyangva-stainye. This means that he walks with his arms and rings.

8.word_for_word: मुखतो हन्तुं कामो यस्य तं बक-वेषम् अरिं बाहुभ्यां मुखतः कथम् अपाटयत् ? — How did he rip the goat-clad enemy from his mouth with his arms who wanted to kill him in the face?; ॥८-११॥ — ॥8-11॥
8.translation: How did he rip the goat-clad enemy from his mouth with his arms who wanted to kill him in the face? ॥8-11॥

12.word_for_word: आशी-विषतमोऽतिक्रूर-विषश् चासाव् अहीन्द्रश् च तम् ॥१२॥ — The most cruel venom of the serpent and the king of the serpents.
12.translation: The most cruel venom of the serpent and the king of the serpents.

13.word_for_word: औत्पत्तिकः स्वाभाविकः कथम् ? — How is the natural natural?; इति किं सर्वेषाम् आत्मायं स्याद् इति शङ्का ॥१३॥ — I doubt whether this is the self of all.
13.translation: How is the natural natural? I doubt whether this is the self of all.

14.word_for_word: उक्तम् अप्य् अतिविस्मयेन अभिनयेन वदन्ति---क्व सप्त-हायन इति ॥१४॥ — Even when it is said, they act with great wonder and say, "Where is the seven-year-old?"
14.translation: Even when it is said, they act with great wonder and say, "Where is the seven-year-old?"

15.word_for_word: प्राक् श्रुतम् एव गर्गाचार्य-वाक्यं तच् चरित-परिशीलनेन निवृत्तासम्भावनस्य नन्दस्य कृष्ण-तत्त्वावबोधकं जातं स इदानीं तेनैव वाक्येन गोपानुपदिशति, श्रूयताम् इति ॥१५.२१॥ — Having heard the words of Garga-ācārya in the past, by examining his character, Nanda, who had ceased to think of them, became aware of the truth of Kṛṣṇa. He now instructs the cowherd men in the same words, saying, 'Listen.
15.translation: Having heard the words of Garga-ācārya in the past, by examining his character, Nanda, who had ceased to think of them, became aware of the truth of Kṛṣṇa. He now instructs the cowherd men in the same words, saying, 'Listen.

22.word_for_word: तस्मात् तस्य कर्मसु विस्मयो नास्तीति नन्दस्योक्तिः ॥२२॥ — Therefore there is no wonder in his actions, says Nanda.
22.translation: Therefore there is no wonder in his actions, says Nanda.

23.word_for_word: इत्य् अद्धा साक्षान् मां प्रति समादिश्य गर्गे च स्व-गृहं गते सति तदानीं तथा मन्यमानोऽपि इदानीं कृष्णं नारायणस्यांशं मन्ये । — When Garga returned to his home after instructing me in this way, I now consider Lord Kṛṣṇa to be a part of Lord Nārāyaṇa, although I thought so at the time.; अत्र हेतुः, अक्लिष्ट-कारिणम् इति ॥२३.२४॥ — The reason here is that it is the cause of the uncomplicated.
23.translation: When Garga returned to his home after instructing me in this way, I now consider Lord Kṛṣṇa to be a part of Lord Nārāyaṇa, although I thought so at the time. The reason here is that it is the cause of the uncomplicated.

25.word_for_word: गोवर्धनोद्धरणं स-परिकरम् अनुस्मरन् प्रकटितैश्वर्यस्य श्री-कृष्णस्य प्रीतिं प्रार्थयते, देव इति । — Remembering the lifting of Govardhana with his equipment, he prays for the pleasure of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the manifested opulence, as God.; यज्ञ-विप्लवेन या रुट् तया देवे इन्द्रे वर्षति सति । — When the root caused by the revolution of the sacrifice rained down on the god Indra,; वज्राश्म-पर्षानिलैर् अशनि-जल-शर्करातीव्र-वायुभिः सीदत् पाल-पशु-स्त्रिय आत्म-शरणं सीदन्तः पालाः पशवः स्त्रियश् च यस्मिंस् तत् तथा, — Thunderbolt, stone, hail, winds, thunder, water, sugar, strong winds, the shepherds, the cattle, the women, the self-refuge, the shepherds, the cattle, and the women in whom that is so,; आत्मा स्वयम् एव शरणं यस्य तद् गोष्ठं दृष्ट्वा अनुकम्पी उत्स्मयन् हसन् प्रौढिम् आविष्कुर्वन् शैलम् उत्पाट्याबलो बालो लीलार्थम् उच्छिलीन्ध्रं यथा तथैकेन करेण बिभ्रहधद् गोष्ठम् अपात् पालितवान् । — Seeing the herd in which the soul itself had taken refuge, the compassionate smiled, laughed, and discovered that he had grown old.; एवं महेन्द्र-मद-भित् गवाम् इन्द्र इत्य् उत्तराध्यायार्थं च स्मरति । — Thus, the Mahendra-mad-bhit remembers the cows as Indra, and for the purpose of the latter chapter.; स एवं-भूतः श्री-कृष्णो नः प्रीयात् प्रीयताम् इति । — May that thus-being Lord Kṛṣṇa be pleased with us and may He be pleased with us.; "षाड्-विंशे दशमे व्यक्तः षड्-विंशो दशमो हरिः । — "The twenty-sixth tenth Hari is manifested in the twenty-sixth tenth.; व्यन्क्तु पञ्च-विंशं मां चतुर्-विंशतितः पृथक्" — Express me twenty-five separately from twenty-four.; : वर्षानिलैः — by the rain winds
25.translation: Remembering the lifting of Govardhana with his equipment, he prays for the pleasure of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the manifested opulence, as God. When the root caused by the revolution of the sacrifice rained down on the god Indra, Thunderbolt, stone, hail, winds, thunder, water, sugar, strong winds, the shepherds, the cattle, the women, the self-refuge, the shepherds, the cattle, and the women in whom that is so, Seeing the herd in which the soul itself had taken refuge, the compassionate smiled, laughed, and discovered that he had grown old. Thus, the Mahendra-mad-bhit remembers the cows as Indra, and for the purpose of the latter chapter. May that thus-being Lord Kṛṣṇa be pleased with us and may He be pleased with us. "The twenty-sixth tenth Hari is manifested in the twenty-sixth tenth. Express me twenty-five separately from twenty-four. by the rain winds
